title: @object-ui/types: the related-list filter and add-picker filter accept a view filter's { or } group, as the spec carriers do
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4

Filing gate: ① follow-up owed — the `@object-ui/types` rider released from #28370 (claim amendment 6546690468; spec seat note 6541155450 on #28370). ⛔ Not a claim.

**Business reason.** Since #28020 (spec half #28380, `f4a8eede37`) a stored view filter list may hold an any-of group `{ or: [rule, ...] }`, and #28370 teaches the console readers to lower it. A related list on a record page (`record:related_list.filter`, and the add-picker's `filter`) is one more carrier of the same list, but its console type still says flat rules only, so an author or host typing that filter in TypeScript cannot write the group the spec accepts, and a typed caller passing it through fails `Type Check UI`.

**Reading (`origin/main` `bede9deaed`).**
- `ui/packages/types/src/record-components.ts` L543 `filter?: ViewFilterRule[];` and L588 `picker: { …; filter?: ViewFilterRule[] }`: the mirror of the related-list carriers, still the flat rule type.
- `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` ≈L154 `filter?: ViewFilterRule[];` (picker) and ≈L264 `filter?: ViewFilterRule[] | FilterNode;`: the component props `record-related-list.tsx` hands the schema's `filter` / `add` to.
- Widening the mirror alone reds `Type Check UI`, because `record-related-list.tsx` passes the widened value to those props (measured by #28370's card thread, 2026-10-31 17:22Z). Runtime is not affected: the related list lowers through `toFilterNodeSafely`, which #28370 teaches the group.

**Wanted.**
1. The two `record-components.ts` fields take the element type (`ViewFilterElement`, flat rule or `{ or }` group) from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, as the spec carriers do.
2. `RelatedList.tsx`'s `filter` and `picker.filter` props accept the same element type.
3. The zod mirror and the parity ledger follow the TS face, if the mirror carries these keys.

**Tests.** A related-list schema with an `{ or }` group type-checks and lowers to an `or` node beside the parent scope; the picker's filter likewise. Ablation: narrowing a prop back to `ViewFilterRule[]` reds the type test.

**Reader who acts.** A `domain:ui` seat, after #28370 lands (it owns the lowering). Surface: `ui/packages/types/src/record-components.ts` (+ zod twin and parity test), `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-related-list.tsx`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on `@object-ui/types`; no `packages/spec` change.

**Dedupe.** Searched "related list filter or group record-components types mirror ViewFilterRule": 5 hits, none covers it (#28370 open is the reader card this was released from; #28020, #7118, #5159, #26348 closed).

Links back: #28370, #28020, #28380.
